title: Miaomiao Bluetooth reconnect
symptom: xDrip loses connection to the miaomiao due to interference with 2.4 GHz WLAN, requiring manual Bluetooth scan and selection of the miaomiao to reconnect. This happens at varying frequencies depending on the environment.
cause: Interference with WLAN in the 2.4 GHz range causes xDrip to lose the Bluetooth connection to the miaomiao.
fix: Turning off the 'Trust Auto-Connect' setting in Bluetooth Settings under Less common settings resolved the issue for one user. Another user reported success after purging the Bluetooth cache, and another after updating the app, optimizing BT settings, and enabling GPS.
evidence_quote: Setting——> Less common settings ——>Bluetooth Settings——>Trust Auto-Connect(Turn it off!)
